churches.assessment: Sen. Edmund S. Muskie (D-ME) — U.S. Senator 1959-1980, Governor of Maine 1955-1959 (the state's first Roman Catholic governor), Secretary of State 1980-1981 under President Carter, and 1968 Democratic vice-presidential nominee — was born March 28, 1914 in Rumford, Maine to Polish immigrant parents Stephen Marciszewski (anglicized to Muskie 1914) and Josephine née Czarnecka. Muskie's first language was Polish; he spoke only Polish until age 4. churches.assessment: St. William of York is the only Catholic church in Stafford County, founded in 1956. Fr. Robert DeMartino has led since 2008 and emphasizes reverence at Mass, devotion to Our Blessed Mother, and frequent confession. The Diocese of Arlington is one of the most theologically conservative Catholic dioceses in America. While Catholic soteriology and Scripture+Tradition differ from Protestant sola fide/sola scriptura, this parish is as reverent and orthodox as Catholic gets. Knights of Columbus provide men's formation.
